description: Build quotes from distributor pricing; enter commercial and DoD sales orders; customer order status
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $4,400 of revenue per business day; commercial customers buy from a competitor if a quote or order is not confirmed within a day; DoD RFQs have fixed response dates
manual_workaround: Quote from the distributor portals and a spreadsheet; confirm orders by phone and email; enter them in the ERP when it returns
dependent_third_parties: ERP vendor; national distributors (pricing); internet provider; MSP
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner; Federal Account Manager; Commercial Account Manager

description: Place purchase orders with distributors, OEM programs, and brokers; drop-ship orders to customer sites
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Most orders are filled by distributor drop-ship or next-day stock; a day without purchasing delays every open order; DoD delivery dates are in the purchase order
manual_workaround: Order directly in the distributor portals and record the purchase orders in a spreadsheet for later entry
dependent_third_parties: National distributors; OEM partner programs; ERP vendor

business_process: Federal order administration and compliance reporting
description: Read and file the clauses on each DoD order; Section 889 check; SAM and SPRS entries; reports to contracting officers and DIBNet
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The FAR 52.204-25(d) report is due within 1 business day of identifying covered equipment, and an outage caused by a supplier or cyber incident can start that clock; losing DoD eligibility ends about 22% of revenue
manual_workaround: Clause files and the contracting officer contact list printed in the incident binder; reports can be made from any clean laptop
dependent_third_parties: Federal Prime; DoD contracting offices; government contracts counsel

description: Receive and inspect stock; asset tagging and configuration at the setup bench; pack and ship; carrier labels
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Setup orders have delivery dates a week or more out; stock can wait in the stockroom; configuration settings come from customer lists kept in email
manual_workaround: Paper receiving log; hand-written asset tag sheet; carrier web portal labels from any laptop
dependent_people_or_facilities: Setup and Receiving Technician; Operations Manager (backup)

description: About 60 customer users order, check status, and download invoices in the ERP's customer portal
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Portal customers can phone or email orders; repeat orders tolerate a day or two
manual_workaround: Take orders by phone and email; enter them in the ERP when it returns

description: Invoice customers; post receipts; pay distributors and brokers; manage supplier bank details
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Distributor terms allow 30 days; the cash reserve covers about 45 days; payment errors are costly (the April 2026 diversion)
manual_workaround: Hold payments until the ERP returns; bank portal for urgent payments to known accounts only, after call-back

description: Answer customer questions; returns (RMA) with distributors and OEMs; warranty claims
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers expect a reply within a business day; returns have distributor deadlines measured in weeks
manual_workaround: Phone and email from any laptop; distributor and OEM return portals
dependent_people_or_facilities: Commercial Account Manager; Federal Account Manager

description: Payroll through an outside service; HR files; contracts, insurance, and security records in the shared drive
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs every two weeks; HR files hold employee personal information (Fla. Stat. 501.171)
manual_workaround: Payroll service repeats the prior payroll; paper copies of key contracts in the office
dependent_third_parties: Payroll service; productivity suite vendor; backup service (through the MSP)
